test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Albert said to Tim, “I’m not sure your father would consider it a good idea to have me on the board of his company.”

options.text: Albert said to Tim that he was not sure his father would consider it a good idea to have me on the board of his company.
Albert said to Tim that I’m not sure your father would consider it a good idea to have me on the board of his company.
Albert said to Tim that he is not sure your father will consider it a good idea to have him on the board of his company.
Albert said to Tim that he was not sure his father would consider it a good idea to have him on the board of his company.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Albert said to Tim that he was not sure his father would consider it a good idea to have him on the board of his company.​'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in Present Simple Tense.
 
• Simple Present Tense changes to Simple Past Tense.
 
• If the reporting verb is in the present or future tense, the tense of the reported clause should not be **change****d.** 
 
• Reporting verb is changed according to the form and sense of the sentence.
 
• Inverted commas are removed in the indirect speech.
 
• Connective word is used at the beginning of the reported speech.
 
• The verb of the reported speech is changed according to the form and sense of the sentence.
 
• Persons & Helping Verbs of the reported speech are changed.
